EXT-D-0068.expected: Only a confirmed single-row soft delete exits; false, thrown, zero, and unknown-count outcomes retain the editor and provide retry.
evidence: src/lib/notes/queries.ts requests count='exact' and returns true only when count === 1 and error is absent
src/features/notes/NoteEditor.tsx retains the editor and exposes Retry delete for false or thrown results
src/features/notes/NotesView.tsx keys NoteEditor by selectedNoteId, so successful selection clearing unmounts it; NoteEditor's unmount cleanup flushes a pending saveTimerRef draft through persist

performDelete does not cancel the pending save timer or clear unsavedDrafts before successful navigation. updateNote then can issue an update to the already soft-deleted row (its patch does not clear deleted_at); if that update fails, persist keeps the draft in unsavedDrafts for later recovery.
EXT-D-0068.finding: Confirmed delete can race with an unmount autosave and leave stale local recovery state. The observed code supports a post-delete content/updated_at update and stale draft retention; it does not support a claim that the row is restored, since updateNote does not clear deleted_at.
EXT-D-0068.coverage_quality: Boundary tests cover zero, one, null, and database error counts; component tests cover false, thrown, and retry-to-success. No test covers success while the debounce timer is pending, canceled saves, or unsavedDrafts cleanup.

count_semantics: Installed @supabase/postgrest-js 2.117.2 source documents update({count:'exact'}) and implements it with Prefer: count=exact, then parses the total from Content-Range. A returned count of 0, null, or more than 1 is distinguishable; count === 1 is a supported confirmation check for this id-filtered update.
